purpose: Pin the immutable official House Journal source artifact produced from the already-selected 24-case Deep development cohort before extracting any Journal mechanics. This stage remains outcome-blind and cannot alter forecasts.

policy.notes: Classify only deterministic bill-specific procedural mechanics from the immutable, strictly pre-vote House Journal pages. Section-bounded list rules and bill-anchored phrases are used to avoid attributing another bill's Journal action to the frozen case. Reaching final-passage procedure is classified only up to the procedural stage phrase; ensuing roll-call results are deliberately excluded.
